notes.title: Huge demo update! Two gamemodes, unlockable palettes and Steam Achievements! 🕯️
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056024/1b2fb91c468aa5082d1846defd6d4c795ee700b3.png[/img]

Hello cultists!

Thanks for your interest in Hot Wax!
[b]We just updated the demo with something that better reflects the full game experience![/b]

The old demo was the prototype we made before starting work on the full game. The full game is made in a less restrictive engine, has a higher resolution, is clearer overall, has more refined controls, and has a few different powerups rather than just the bomb, a few different gamemodes, and unlockable palettes. And it's almost done now! With the Steam Next Fest coming on, we thought it'd be nice to replace the old demo with a fragment of the actual game!

[b]This new demo has the first difficulty for two of the six gamemodes available in the full game, and 7 of the full game's 30 palettes. There are even 4 Steam achievements that you can get by playing the demo![/b]

We hope you have fun with it! If you do, please wishlist Hot Wax and feel free to leave a short positive review on the demo, it all helps a lot!

Have a wonderful day and may we all find our light in the darkness!
[i]-PUNKCAKE Délicieux[/i] 🥞
